seeds.title: branches.parse: \d and $ accept Unicode digits and a trailing newline
seeds.detail: PARSE_ROWS use \d and $ without re.ASCII. A fork PR head such as feature/PROJ-1-M-<fullwidth 2> holds the stack, and feature/PROJ-1-M-1-e2e<LF> gets a merge command. Git forbids newlines, GitHub rejects them, so only the digit form is reachable. Fix: re.ASCII and \Z. The old sdlc/M-[^/]+ check was looser, so this is no regression.

seeds.title: lowercased format: re.IGNORECASE folds Kelvin sign and long s into ASCII
seeds.detail: A local branch with U+212A matches ledger id S-K1 under {name:lower}. Branch creation needs repo write, which is trusted.

seeds.title: state prefix fallback merges any ready head starting with state-
seeds.detail: The spec requires the fallback. A fork PR head feature/PROJ-1-state-x that is green and mergeable gets gh pr merge in pr mode. Same exposure as sdlc/state- on main. Consider requiring the PR author to be the run owner.
